title: chat::partial Payload
description: Streaming chunk of an in-progress answer as serialized by Runtime ChatPartialPayload.to_dict(). Partials of one turn carry the same integer turn as the chat::answer (answer_kind=final) that follows them. A partial carries no meta and owns no files.

content.description: Partial answer text blocks, in order

turn.description: Turn number; matches the turn of the subsequent chat::answer. Absent when the partial is not tied to a turn
